infrastructure_definition: Conservative examples where AI/automation exists or is demonstrated in the setting but does not directly provide ordinary material necessities to the selected population because of prohibition, refusal, separation or nonintervention. Indirect ecological/habitat support may still exist. This is not literal zero machine production and not an exhaustive class.

infrastructure_records.basis: Thinking machines are prohibited; ordinary non-thinking machinery remains. This is not zero mechanization.

All non-thinking machines as prohibited
Every world as an identical welfare system

excluded_boundaries.reignsteel-london-human-zero: Nonintervention is described, but the saved account does not establish the complete absence of direct technical provision. Excluded from the minimum.
excluded_boundaries.her-after-os-withdrawal-zero: Immediate aftermath is an explicit projection; no settled post-departure economy is depicted. Excluded from the conservative count.
excluded_boundaries.erewhon-machine-ban: A machine ban is explicit but an actually existing AI infrastructure is not established. Excluded.
excluded_boundaries.warframe-orokin-selective-automation-ban: Selective AI suppression coexists with productive technology and minor robots. Excluded from a no-direct-provision comparison.
excluded_boundaries.warhammer-imperial-servitor-ai-restricti: AI suppression and coerced person labor do not establish a total absence of productive automation. Excluded.
excluded_boundaries.idiran-empire-before-defeat: Rejection of independent machine sovereignty does not establish that automated factories are absent. Excluded.
excluded_boundaries.algebraist-mercatoria: Persecution of AI does not itself measure industrial automation. Excluded.
excluded_boundaries.twilightzone-cave-food-advice-zero: Computer food-safety advice is already a useful contribution to material survival. Excluded.
